modmenu.summaryTranslation.lava_boat_clu: Fixes lava boat clutch mechanic, I suppose
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Restores lava boat clutch mechanic that got fixed in 1.21.5.

On first lava contact the boat gets a short immunity time, so player can land on its hitbox.

Now you can do lava clutches like Dream but in newer versions!
config.lava_boat_clutch.title: Lava Boat Clutch Fix Settings
config.lava_boat_clutch.enable_mod.toolt: Enables or disables the lava boat clutch mechanic.
config.lava_boat_clutch.immunity_ticks.t: The number of ticks in which the boat does not burn in the lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_mode:
Default: uses vanilla velocity
Custom: uses configurable velocity.
Random: uses random velocity.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_y.to: Upward velocity applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_x.to: Lateral velocity along the X axis applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_z.to: Lateral velocity along the Z axis applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
